title: Puthiya Vaanam
desc: Pandidurai adopts a military officer's son, Rajaratnam, after Govindan, a criminal, kills him. However, years later, Rajaratnam becomes a policeman and must take down Govindan and his henchman.

title: Naan Petha Magane
desc: Aandal, a possessive mother, sabotages her son's love life by attempting suicide. However, when she gets him married to a village girl, her possessiveness resurfaces.

title: Veerapandiyan
desc: Ranjith along with his two aides plan to rob a temple. As they strive to execute their plan, they face multiple challenges.

title: Ejamaan
desc: Vaanavaryan, the much-loved leader of a village, invites his rival Vallavarayan's wrath when he marries Vaitheeswari, the woman he loves. To take revenge, Vallavarayan resorts to drastic measures.

title: Nakshathiram
desc: Ravi, an aspiring filmmaker, faces challenges in directing his first film while navigating his personal struggles. Later, he falls in love with a dancer, Sandya.

title: Ilaiyavan
desc: Sathyan, a stand-up college student, meets Kausalya, a sweet young woman, on a bus and falls for her. However, a misunderstanding between them leads to them becoming estranged.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Kasethan Kadavulada
desc: Ramu, a young man, ropes his acquaintances into an intricate plan to steal money from his evil stepmother.
